items.prompt: An invalid final request follows valid rows. What is returned?

options.why: The pure function publishes only a completed return.

options.text: Earlier rows marked complete for every request
Earlier valid rows plus a zero-filled substitute for the invalid row
options.why: That would hide the failure and return a batch the all-or-error interface does not promise.

options.text: A zero price substituted for the invalid row

items.explanation: All-or-error pure return does not itself implement concurrent/durable publication.
